versions.short: The bill would designate the America's National Churchill Museum, including the Winston Churchill Memorial at Westminster College in Fulton, Missouri, as a National Historic Landmark. It would let the Department of the Interior sign cooperative agreements with public and private groups to protect historic resources at the site and to provide educational and visitor facilities, and it would allow the department to give those partners technical and financial help. It would also require Interior to study the site's national significance, whether it could become a unit of the National Park System, and other ways to preserve and interpret it, including cost estimates for each option.
